tasks.short: Maintain advertiser relationships, develop accounts and agree next commercial actions.

steps.what: Review account history, open opportunities and renewal dates.
Read recent correspondence and assemble an account brief.

loop.input: Account-linked correspondence, campaign reports and account activity summary.
loop.output: A short account brief with source references and unresolved questions.
loop.check: Validate account identifiers and source references; the seller checks commercial meaning.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; missing or conflicting facts become questions for the seller.
loop.why_not_simpler: Client priorities and concerns sit in free text. Structured account fields supply the factual backbone.

steps.what: Choose accounts to contact and set meeting objectives.
Discuss campaign performance, business needs and upcoming advertising plans.
Agree campaign objectives, responsibilities and next commercial actions.
Update account records and write the campaign brief.
Send the follow-up and arrange agreed meetings or internal actions.

tasks.design: Configure account views, structured meeting notes and action templates in the {CRM}, linked to {EMAIL} and {CALENDAR}. A bounded drafting loop prepares source-linked briefs from approved correspondence in {EMAIL} and reports in {DOCS}. The seller chooses priorities, leads client conversations and approves external follow-ups.
tasks.previous_blocker: Account context was scattered across records and correspondence. Useful preparation required reading, while relationship decisions resisted fixed rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing account views and workflow configuration handle most administration. AI-assisted coding reduces the effort of connecting records, while a bounded loop handles correspondence.
tasks.still_hard: Attribution, agency relationships and changing advertiser priorities remain uncertain. GDPR and national rules affect access to correspondence and changes to employee activity tracking.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise an unstated concern, repair trust after a weak campaign and judge when to ask for more business.

ambition.what: Weekly decisions on which at-risk advertiser renewals need a recovery meeting.

tasks.altitude: The week shifts from reconstructing account history toward recovery conversations and campaign planning. Within existing delegation, the seller chooses recovery meetings and standard follow-up actions; pricing authority does not expand.

reach.task: Triage renewal risks across a small account portfolio.
reach.learn: Revenue concentration, renewal forecasting and escalation thresholds.

reach.task: Develop a structured account growth plan.
reach.learn: Stakeholder mapping and discovery beyond the current advertising purchase.

evidence.claim: Account views, structured notes and configured follow-ups can reduce account administration without automating relationship decisions.
Teamleader combines CRM records and online quote signing, and its Focus AI acts after approval.
The proposed time shares, remaining effort and build ranges are planning estimates.

assumptions: The baseline represents a mixed portfolio of recurring advertisers and developing accounts.
Human conversations account for half the task; the communication-heavy prior is retained.
The target uses typed notes rather than introducing call recording or seller scoring.
Consultation and access ranges include national employee consultation where applicable; they are not statutory deadlines.
unknowns: Whether account correspondence and campaign reports can be linked reliably to account identifiers.
Which account views, templates and integrations are already licensed and configured.
The seller's actual authority over recovery actions and commercial concessions.
Whether proposed activity tracking requires national employee consultation.
research_questions: Which account facts are repeatedly reconstructed before meetings?
Does a source-linked brief change meeting preparation time or renewal decisions?
Which structured note fields preserve useful context without increasing administration?
new_work: Review account briefs and correct misleading summaries.
Resolve unmatched correspondence and stale renewal dates.
Maintain note templates, access permissions and follow-up rules.

tasks.short: Recommend advertising sizes and formats that fit the advertiser's objectives, medium and practical constraints.

steps.what: Read the advertiser's request and clarify objectives, budget and creative constraints.

loop.output: Structured objectives, medium, dates, budget and creative constraints.
loop.check: Require source references for extracted values; validate dates, currencies and required fields.
loop.stop: One extraction and one repair; ambiguous or missing requirements return to the seller.
loop.why_not_simpler: Advertisers describe requirements in free text. Existing structured fields are reused without model processing.

steps.what: Look up current format specifications and creative submission requirements.
Compare eligible sizes and formats against objectives and budget.
Check candidate formats against available advertising inventory and production deadlines.
Explain trade-offs and agree the preferred format with the advertiser.
Send the recommended media plan and creative specifications.

tasks.design: Keep versioned media specifications and eligibility rules in the {DOCS} and a small rules service on the {DATA_PLATFORM}. A bounded extraction loop turns mailed requirements into fields; deterministic code produces a comparison using approved rates and availability from the {OPS_SYSTEM}. A configured {CRM} template assembles the media plan for seller approval and delivery through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specifications, rate cards and inventory were maintained separately. The seller had to translate informal requests into comparable options.
tasks.enabler_now: A small rules service and document templates are inexpensive to build and connect. Free-text extraction can be bounded by required fields and source checks.
tasks.still_hard: Creative suitability and likely audience response are not fully specified by eligibility rules. Availability can change between recommendation and booking.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why a technically valid format may fail creatively, and uncover what the advertiser really needs.

ambition.what: First-time regional advertisers needing a simple, affordable format consultation.

tasks.altitude: The seller spends less time checking specifications and more time comparing creative trade-offs with advertisers. They can recommend standard eligible formats within existing authority; exceptions still need the relevant commercial or production approval.

reach.task: Translate campaign requirements into a technically feasible media configuration.
reach.learn: Constraint modelling, inventory limitations and production validation.

reach.task: Show how the same creative works across advertising formats.
reach.learn: Creative examples, visual explanation and medium-specific limitations.

evidence.claim: Format eligibility, dimensions, deadlines and approved rate calculations can be encoded as deterministic rules.
Free-text requirements can be extracted into a checked schema while creative suitability remains subject to seller review.
No supplied source documents this exact advertising-format solution; effort and build ranges are estimates.

assumptions: The baseline uses documents for specifications, a comparison workbook and an operations screen for inventory.
Technical eligibility is more rule-covered than creative suitability; the latter retains human review and conversation.
Availability checks do not reserve inventory or promise delivery.
Consultation and access estimates include national employee consultation if the implementation changes employee monitoring.
unknowns: Whether specifications and rate cards have authoritative owners and effective dates.
Whether inventory can be read through an interface or only through exports.
Which formats require production review before a recommendation.
Whether creative examples contain restricted client material or personal data subject to GDPR.
research_questions: Which format decisions follow stable rules, and which depend on creative judgement?
How often do outdated specifications cause rejected creative or rework?
Can existing configuration provide the comparison before custom code is needed?
new_work: Maintain specification versions, eligibility rules and approved examples.
Review extracted requirements and unusual recommendations.
Handle stale availability and production exceptions.
Check that generated plans use the correct specification version.

tasks.short: Find suitable prospective advertisers, check contact permissions and start commercial conversations.

steps.what: Search public business directories for potential advertisers.
Check existing records and remove duplicate or already assigned prospects.
Read business websites to assess advertising fit and a useful contact reason.

loop.input: A fixed set of permitted public business pages and explicit target account criteria.
loop.output: A prospect brief with fit reasons, supporting sources and uncertainty.
loop.check: Require a source for each business fact; exclude unsupported need, budget and personal inferences.
loop.stop: At most five pages and one model pass per prospect; inaccessible or ambiguous cases return to the seller.
loop.why_not_simpler: Business descriptions vary in free text. Exact industry and location filters run before this step.

steps.what: Check contact permissions, suppression records and permitted communication channels.
Write a relevant introductory message using the available advertising offer.

loop.input: Reviewed prospect brief, approved media facts and an approved outreach structure.
loop.check: Check factual claims against inputs; reject unsupported performance promises, rates and personalisation.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; failed checks fall back to the approved template.
loop.why_not_simpler: A relevant opening sometimes needs paraphrasing business context; standard introductions use templates directly.

steps.what: Send the introductory message to the selected prospect.
Call eligible prospects to explore interest and qualify a possible campaign.
Record the response, qualification outcome and follow-up date.

tasks.design: A deterministic import on the {DATA_PLATFORM} brings permitted business listings into the {CRM}, removes duplicates and checks channel eligibility against maintained rules. Bounded loops prepare source-linked prospect briefs and optional message drafts; configured {EMAIL} sending requires seller approval and a fresh eligibility check. Human calls through the {TELEPHONY} feed a short structured qualification form in the {CRM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prospect research was fragmented, contact rules were checked manually and relevant introductions took time to write. Sending more messages did not solve qualification or trust.
tasks.enabler_now: Configured deduplication, deterministic eligibility checks and small integrations handle the repeatable work. Bounded reading and drafting handle varied business descriptions without autonomous outreach.
tasks.still_hard: Public contact details do not establish permission to market. GDPR, national channel rules, data licensing and uncertain commercial fit remain constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Earn attention, handle objections and distinguish polite interest from a genuine advertising opportunity.

ambition.what: Relevant local businesses outside the existing advertiser referral network.

tasks.altitude: The seller spends more time on qualified conversations and less time searching and copying records. They gain a clearer choice of eligible prospects; authority over pricing and campaign commitments stays unchanged.

reach.learn: Channel eligibility, concise discovery and respectful objection handling.

reach.task: Evaluate which prospect segments create viable opportunities.
reach.learn: Cohort conversion, acquisition effort and selection bias.

evidence.claim: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales has a qualification agent that researches leads, judges fit and sends outreach.
The Netherlands requires prior opt-in for calls to consumers, sole traders and general partnerships from 1 July 2026, including existing customers.
Dutch guidance allows calls to specified corporate legal forms subject to identification and other calling requirements; this is not a Europe-wide rule.
Deduplication and explicit channel rules can run deterministically; uncertain eligibility can block contact for manual resolution.
Research and record checking can occupy more time than the supplied meeting-heavy prior suggests; the proposed shares require observation.

assumptions: Prospecting includes desk research, an initial message and a qualification call; not every prospect reaches every stage.
Listing access is permitted and does not depend on bypassing website restrictions.
Unknown contact eligibility blocks outreach; a model cannot infer consent.
The target introduces no AI caller, call recording or seller scoring.
Consultation and access ranges include national employee consultation where activity tracking changes.
unknowns: Which countries, legal forms and communication channels the team targets.
Whether permission evidence, objections and suppression records are complete.
Which listing sources permit the intended access and reuse.
Whether existing configuration already supports deduplication and approval before sending.
research_questions: Which prospect facts predict useful conversations without speculative personal profiling?
How much research can existing filters eliminate before a model reads business pages?
Which eligibility checks need legal interpretation before becoming maintained rules?
Does researched outreach improve qualified responses enough to justify its data and review costs?
new_work: Maintain country-specific channel rules and suppression synchronisation.
Review prospect briefs and outbound message drafts.
Resolve uncertain legal forms, identities and permissions.
Monitor source changes, data quality and prospecting costs.

tasks.short: Prepare advertising agreements, obtain signatures and coordinate collection of payments.

steps.what: Gather agreed campaign details, prices and billing information.
Populate the advertising agreement from the approved contract template.
Discuss requested changes to campaign commitments, cancellation terms or payment dates.
Approve commercial exceptions within delegated limits or escalate for legal review.
Check the final agreement and send it for advertiser signature.
Create and send the invoice after the contractual billing trigger.
Match bank receipts to invoices and identify overdue balances.
Send routine payment reminders for undisputed overdue invoices.
Discuss disputed invoices or missed commitments and agree the next collection action.

tasks.design: Validated deal fields from the {CRM} populate approved templates in the {DOCS}; configured approvals and the {ESIGN} control agreement release. The signed agreement and billing trigger feed the {ERP}, where configured reconciliation matches receipts from the {BANK} and routes ambiguous matches to finance review. The {ERP} sends policy-based reminders through {EMAIL}, suppressing disputed invoices and leaving negotiation with people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sales, signature and finance records were disconnected. Nonstandard clauses and payment disputes made the whole task appear inseparable from human judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Template generation, signature workflows, reconciliation and reminders are established capabilities. AI-assisted coding makes missing field mappings and validation cheaper to implement.
tasks.still_hard: Nonstandard liability, cancellation disputes, campaign underdelivery and uncertain payment references need judgement. GDPR, confidential contract access and national contract rules still apply.
tasks.human_edge: Negotiate a fair resolution while protecting the advertiser relationship and the company's commercial position.
tasks.altitude: The seller spends less time assembling agreements and chasing routine balances, with more time for disputed commitments and account recovery. Decision rights over discounts, credits and legal terms do not change.

reach.task: Validate the handoff from agreed campaign to billable order.
reach.learn: Billing triggers, order identifiers and duplicate-invoice prevention.

reach.task: Prepare a recommendation on a commercial contract exception.
reach.learn: Margin exposure, cancellation risk and delegated approval limits.

evidence.claim: Teamleader supports CRM records and quotes signed online; its Focus AI acts after approval.
Structured deal fields and approved clauses support deterministic agreement generation without a drafting model.
Invoice generation, bank matching and reminder schedules are established finance-system configuration patterns.
The supplied evidence does not establish end-to-end advertising contract or collection savings; effort and build ranges are estimates.

assumptions: Prices and campaign terms have been agreed before contract preparation; this task does not create new pricing authority.
The baseline includes the surrounding finance handoffs because collecting payment crosses roles.
Time shares are blended across routine agreements and exceptions; exception approval is conditional.
Receipt review covers ambiguous matches; exact matches can post under approved rules.
Routine reminders use an approved schedule and stop when payment, a dispute or a payment commitment is recorded.
Consultation and access estimates include national employee consultation where the change affects employee monitoring.
unknowns: Whether signed agreement fields and billing triggers can pass reliably into the finance records.
Which contract amendments need commercial approval, legal approval or both.
Whether bank matching and reminder functions are already available and configured.
How campaign delivery affects billing, disputes and collection holds.
Who may approve credits, revised payment terms and collection escalation.
research_questions: Which contract fields are re-entered between sales, signature and finance?
Which existing configuration can replace manual work before custom integration is built?
What causes unmatched receipts and inappropriate reminders?
Which exception types account for most negotiation and collection effort?
new_work: Maintain approved clauses, field mappings and billing-trigger rules.
Review agreements before signature requests and assess commercial exceptions.
Resolve ambiguous receipts and failed invoice handoffs.
Maintain dispute holds, payment commitments and reminder policies.
Check for duplicate invoices and inconsistent contract versions.

role.altitude: The advertising sales agent spends more of the week on discovery, creative trade-offs, negotiation and account recovery. Preparation and administration become shorter; broader commercial authority requires explicit delegation.
reach: Sales manager: prepare renewal-risk priorities and commercial exception recommendations.
Sales engineer: translate advertiser requirements into technically feasible formats.
Telemarketer: qualify eligible prospects through focused first conversations.
skills_to_grow: Source checking and concise review of generated drafts.
Contact permissions, GDPR and national channel rules.
Contract economics, billing triggers and dispute resolution.
role.ambitious_version: Offer a guided first-campaign service for regional advertisers, combining permission-aware prospecting, a clear format consultation and reliable agreement-to-payment coordination. Build the service around approved commercial limits, with the seller accountable for client understanding and negotiated commitments.
